title: 🇺🇸 Inglês - Revisão Completa 🌟
description: Lista extensa com 105 exercícios de inglês baseados no material de revisão, cobrindo clima, verbo 'to be', 'there was/were', comparativos, superlativos, pronomes possessivos, present simple, present continuous e leitura de textos.

exercises.question: What's the weather like in the picture with clouds? ☁️
exercises.explicacao: Quando há nuvens no céu, o clima está nublado (cloudy).
exercises.dica: Olhe para as nuvens no céu!

exercises.question: What activities can you do when it's raining? 🌧️
exercises.explicacao: Quando está chovendo, uma atividade divertida é pular nas poças d'água (puddles).
exercises.dica: O que podemos fazer com a água da chuva?

exercises.question: When it's snowing, everything is _____! ❄️
exercises.explicacao: Quando está nevando, tudo fica branco por causa da neve.
exercises.dica: Qual é a cor da neve?

exercises.question: What do we wear when it's cold and windy? 🧥
exercises.explicacao: Quando está frio e ventoso, vestimos botas, casaco e cachecol para nos aquecer.
exercises.dica: Que roupas nos deixam quentinhos?

exercises.question: The sun starts shining and it's nice and _____ today! ☀️
exercises.explicacao: Quando o sol está brilhando, o dia está ensolarado (sunny).
exercises.dica: Como chamamos um dia com muito sol?

exercises.question: Complete: 'I _____ eight years old.'
exercises.explicacao: Com o pronome 'I' (eu), sempre usamos 'am' no verbo to be.
exercises.dica: I sempre vem com 'am'.

exercises.question: Complete: 'She _____ very happy.'
exercises.explicacao: Com 'she' (ela), usamos 'is' no presente do verbo to be.
exercises.dica: She, he e it usam 'is'.

exercises.question: Complete: 'They _____ at school.'
exercises.explicacao: Com 'they' (eles/elas), usamos 'are' no presente do verbo to be.
exercises.dica: You, we e they usam 'are'.

exercises.question: Yesterday I _____ very happy! (past simple of 'to be')
exercises.explicacao: No passado, com 'I' usamos 'was'.
exercises.dica: I, he, she, it usam 'was' no passado.

exercises.question: Last week you _____ late for class. (past simple of 'to be')
exercises.explicacao: No passado, com 'you' usamos 'were'.
exercises.dica: You, we, they usam 'were' no passado.

exercises.question: Complete the negative form: 'She _____ at home yesterday.'
exercises.explicacao: 'Wasn't' é a forma negativa de 'was' (was not).
exercises.dica: She usa 'was', então a negativa é 'wasn't'.

exercises.question: Complete the interrogative form: '_____ you sick yesterday?'
exercises.explicacao: Em perguntas no passado com 'you', usamos 'Were you...?'
exercises.dica: You sempre usa 'were' nas perguntas do passado.

exercises.question: There _____ a dog on the bed yesterday.
exercises.explicacao: Usamos 'there was' com substantivos no singular no passado.
exercises.dica: 'A dog' é singular, então usamos 'was'.

exercises.question: There _____ many kids at the party yesterday.
exercises.explicacao: Usamos 'there were' com substantivos no plural no passado.
exercises.dica: 'Many kids' é plural, então usamos 'were'.

exercises.question: Complete: 'There _____ four people in the house last night.'
exercises.explicacao: 'Four people' é plural, então usamos 'there were' no passado.
exercises.dica: Números maiores que um são sempre plurais.

exercises.question: Mark is _____ than Philippe. (tall)
exercises.explicacao: Para adjetivos curtos, adicionamos '-er' para formar o comparativo.
exercises.dica: Comparativo de adjetivos curtos: adicione '-er'.

exercises.question: Complete: 'My friend is _____ than you.' (happy)
exercises.explicacao: Adjetivos terminados em 'y' trocam o 'y' por 'ier' no comparativo.
exercises.dica: Happy → happier (y vira ier).

exercises.question: Water is _____ than oil. (heavy)
exercises.explicacao: Heavy termina em 'y', então vira 'heavier' no comparativo.
exercises.dica: Lembre-se: y → ier nos comparativos.

exercises.question: Complete: 'Juice is _____ than water.' (good)
exercises.explicacao: 'Good' tem comparativo irregular: good → better → best.
exercises.dica: Good, better, best - é uma exceção!

exercises.question: A Mercedes is _____ than a Fiat. (expensive)
exercises.explicacao: Adjetivos longos (3+ sílabas) usam 'more + adjetivo' no comparativo.
exercises.dica: Adjetivos longos usam 'more'.

exercises.question: Complete with superlative: 'This movie is the _____ I love it!' (good)
exercises.explicacao: 'Good' tem superlativo irregular: good → better → best.
exercises.dica: O superlativo de 'good' é 'best'.

exercises.question: You are the _____ girl in the world! (happy)
exercises.explicacao: Adjetivos terminados em 'y': y → iest no superlativo.
exercises.dica: Happy → happiest (y vira iest).

exercises.question: Complete: 'John is the _____ boy in class.' (tall)
exercises.explicacao: Adjetivos curtos: the + adj + est no superlativo.
exercises.dica: Tall → tallest (adicione -est).

exercises.question: This is the _____ shirt that you have. (ugly)
exercises.explicacao: Ugly termina em 'y', então: y → iest = ugliest.
exercises.dica: Ugly → ugliest (y vira iest).

exercises.question: Complete: 'This book is _____.' (you - possessive pronoun)
exercises.explicacao: Quando não há substantivo após, usamos o pronome possessivo 'yours'.
exercises.dica: Your book → This book is yours.

exercises.question: The ball is _____. (I - possessive pronoun)
exercises.explicacao: 'Mine' é o pronome possessivo para 'I'.
exercises.dica: My ball → The ball is mine.

exercises.question: Complete: 'The blue car is _____.' (we - possessive pronoun)
exercises.explicacao: 'Ours' é o pronome possessivo para 'we'.
exercises.dica: Our car → The car is ours.

exercises.question: The ring is _____. (she - possessive pronoun)
exercises.explicacao: 'Hers' é o pronome possessivo para 'she'.
exercises.dica: Her ring → The ring is hers.

exercises.question: Complete with possessive adjective: 'This is _____ book.' (I)
exercises.explicacao: Antes de um substantivo, usamos o adjetivo possessivo 'my'.
exercises.dica: Antes de substantivo: my, your, his, her...

exercises.question: Where is _____ friend? (you - possessive adjective)
exercises.explicacao: Antes de 'friend', usamos o adjetivo possessivo 'your'.
exercises.dica: Antes de substantivo usamos adjetivos possessivos.

exercises.question: She usually _____ to school by bus.
exercises.explicacao: No Present Simple, com he/she/it adicionamos 's' ao verbo.
exercises.dica: She goes (3ª pessoa adiciona 's').

exercises.question: They often _____ us. (visit)
exercises.explicacao: Com 'they', o verbo não muda no Present Simple.
exercises.dica: I, you, we, they → verbo sem 's'.

exercises.question: Complete the negative: 'You _____ basketball once a week.'
exercises.explicacao: Para I, you, we, they usamos 'don't' + verbo.
exercises.dica: Don't = do not (para I, you, we, they).

exercises.question: Tom _____ every day. (work - negative)
exercises.explicacao: Para he, she, it usamos 'doesn't' + verbo.
exercises.dica: Doesn't = does not (para he, she, it).

exercises.question: Complete: 'He always _____ us funny stories.'
exercises.explicacao: Com 'he', adicionamos 's' ao verbo no Present Simple.
exercises.dica: He tells (3ª pessoa adiciona 's').

exercises.question: Catherine _____ a cake for her sister's birthday party now. (cook - Present Continuous)
exercises.explicacao: Present Continuous: verbo to be + verbo + ing (ação acontecendo agora).
exercises.dica: 'Now' indica Present Continuous.

exercises.question: Complete: 'John _____ to read comics.' (like - habit)
exercises.explicacao: Para hábitos, usamos Present Simple. Com 'he' adiciona 's'.
exercises.dica: Hábitos = Present Simple.

exercises.question: It's raining, so Connor and I _____ DVDs now. (watch - Present Continuous)
exercises.explicacao: Ação acontecendo agora = Present Continuous (are + watching).
exercises.dica: 'Now' e 'it's raining' indicam ação atual.

exercises.question: Complete the negative: 'I _____ to listen to music when I study.'
exercises.explicacao: Preferência é Present Simple. Com 'I' usamos 'don't'.
exercises.dica: Gostos e preferências = Present Simple.

exercises.question: What _____ you _____ right now? It smells delicious! (eat - Present Continuous question)
exercises.explicacao: Pergunta no Present Continuous: What are you eating?
exercises.dica: 'Right now' indica Present Continuous.

exercises.question: From the poem, what does the girl do when it's raining? 🌧️
exercises.explicacao: No poema, ela pula nas poças quando está chovendo.
exercises.dica: Releia o primeiro verso do poema.

exercises.question: In the poem, when it's windy, the trees are _____ from side to side. 🌬️
exercises.explicacao: O poema diz: 'The trees are dancing from side to side'.
exercises.dica: Como as árvores se movem no vento?

exercises.question: What does the girl imagine when it's cloudy? ☁️
options: She imagines animals in the clouds
exercises.resposta_correta: She imagines animals in the clouds
exercises.explicacao: Ela imagina elefantes, coelhos e cavalos correndo nas nuvens.
exercises.dica: O que ela vê nas formas das nuvens?

exercises.question: When it's sunny and hot, the girl loves splashing at the _____! ☀️
exercises.explicacao: No poema: 'I love splashing at the pool!'
exercises.dica: Onde vamos nos refrescar quando está quente?

exercises.question: In the kangaroo story, why was the wombat crying? 😢
options: He couldn't see and had no friends
exercises.resposta_correta: He couldn't see and had no friends
exercises.explicacao: O wombat disse: 'I can't see and I haven't got any friends to help me!'
exercises.dica: Leia o que o wombat responde quando perguntado.

exercises.question: The kangaroo was very _____ to the old wombat. 🦘
exercises.explicacao: A história mostra que o canguru foi gentil e ajudou o wombat.
exercises.dica: Como a canguru tratou o wombat?

exercises.question: What did the wombat give the kangaroo as a present? 🎁
exercises.explicacao: O wombat deu uma bolsa (pouch) para o canguru carregar seu bebê.
exercises.dica: O que todos os cangurus têm para carregar seus filhotes?

exercises.question: A joey is a baby _____. 🦘
exercises.explicacao: O texto explica: 'A joey's a baby kangaroo.'
exercises.dica: Como chamamos um filhote de canguru?

exercises.question: From Sammy's text, how old is he? 👦
exercises.explicacao: Sammy diz: 'My name is Sammy and I am eight years old.'
exercises.dica: Leia a primeira linha do texto do Sammy.

exercises.question: Sammy doesn't have to go to school because today is _____. 📅
exercises.explicacao: Sammy diz: 'Today is Saturday so I don't have to go to school.'
exercises.dica: Que dia da semana não temos aula?

exercises.question: What is the weather like in Sammy's story? 🌦️
exercises.explicacao: Sammy diz: 'today it is raining a lot. It's also very windy and cold'
exercises.dica: Por que Sammy tem que ficar em casa?

exercises.question: Sammy doesn't have a brother or a _____, so he plays with his toys. 👨‍👩‍👧‍👦
exercises.explicacao: O texto diz: 'I don't have a brother or a sister'
exercises.dica: Qual palavra completa 'brother or a...'?

exercises.question: What are Sammy and his parents doing? 📺
exercises.explicacao: Sammy diz: 'my parents and I are watching a movie on the TV'
exercises.dica: O que eles estão fazendo na TV?

exercises.question: Name one piece of clothing: T-_____
exercises.explicacao: T-shirt é uma camiseta, uma peça de roupa comum.
exercises.dica: Uma roupa que usamos na parte de cima do corpo.

exercises.question: What do we wear on our feet? 👟
exercises.explicacao: Boots (botas) são calçados que vestimos nos pés.
exercises.dica: O que protege nossos pés?

exercises.question: When it's cold, we wear a _____ around our neck.
exercises.explicacao: Scarf (cachecol) é usado ao redor do pescoço para nos aquecer.
exercises.dica: O que vestimos no pescoço quando está frio?

exercises.question: Complete: 'Today is the _____ day of the year!' (hot - superlative)
exercises.explicacao: Hot é adjetivo curto: hot → hotter → hottest.
exercises.dica: Adjetivos de uma sílaba: duplica consoante + est.

exercises.question: Elephants are the _____ animals in the zoo. (fat - superlative)
exercises.explicacao: Fat → fattest (duplica 't' + est).
exercises.dica: Adjetivos CVC duplicam a última consoante.

exercises.question: Complete with the superlative: 'Tigers are the _____ animals.' (quick)
exercises.explicacao: Quick → quickest (adjetivo curto + est).
exercises.dica: Adjetivos curtos: the + adj + est.

exercises.question: The sun is _____ the mountains. (position)
exercises.explicacao: O sol fica acima (above) das montanhas no céu.
exercises.dica: Onde fica o sol em relação às montanhas?

exercises.question: How often do you watch TV? (frequency question)
exercises.explicacao: 'How often' pergunta sobre frequência, respondemos com advérbios de frequência.
exercises.dica: How often = com que frequência.

exercises.question: I _____ play badminton. (frequency: 0%)
exercises.explicacao: Never = nunca (0% de frequência).
exercises.dica: Qual advérbio significa 0% de frequência?

exercises.question: She _____ studies English. (frequency: 100%)
exercises.explicacao: Always = sempre (100% de frequência).
exercises.dica: Qual advérbio significa 100% de frequência?

exercises.question: They _____ listen to music. (frequency: many times)
exercises.explicacao: Often = frequentemente (muitas vezes).
exercises.dica: Qual advérbio significa 'muitas vezes'?

exercises.question: What's your favorite weather?
exercises.explicacao: Esta é a resposta correta para perguntar sobre clima favorito.
exercises.dica: Responda com 'My favorite is...' + tipo de clima.

exercises.question: In the story, all mummy kangaroos have _____ to carry their babies.
exercises.explicacao: O final da história diz que todas as mamães cangurus têm bolsas (pouches).
exercises.dica: Como os cangurus carregam seus bebês?

exercises.question: Complete: '_____ your best friend?' (She - interrogative past)
exercises.explicacao: Pergunta no passado com 'she': Was she...?
exercises.dica: She usa 'was' no passado.

exercises.question: He _____ a new teacher. (negative past)
exercises.explicacao: 'He' usa 'wasn't' na forma negativa do passado.
exercises.dica: He, she, it usam 'wasn't'.

exercises.question: What do you do when you're sad?
exercises.explicacao: Esta é a resposta mais natural usando Present Simple para hábitos.
exercises.dica: Use Present Simple para falar sobre o que você faz em geral.

exercises.question: My house is _____ than yours. (small)
exercises.explicacao: Comparativo de 'small' é 'smaller' (small + er).
exercises.dica: Than indica comparativo (-er).

exercises.question: The kangaroo finds her joey sleeping under the _____ tree.
exercises.explicacao: A história diz: 'He's asleep below the biggest tree.'
exercises.dica: Releia onde a canguru encontra seu bebê.

exercises.question: This chocolate cake is so _____! (delicious)
exercises.explicacao: Bolo de chocolate é geralmente bom/gostoso.
exercises.dica: Como descrevemos algo gostoso?

exercises.question: Complete: 'It's Sunday, so I _____ to the beach with my friends right now.'
exercises.explicacao: 'Right now' indica Present Continuous: am going.
exercises.dica: 'Right now' = ação acontecendo agora.

exercises.question: Riley _____ the piano on Mondays. (habit)
exercises.explicacao: 'On Mondays' indica hábito, então Present Simple: plays.
exercises.dica: Dias da semana indicam rotina/hábito.

exercises.question: What are you eating right now? It smells delicious!
exercises.explicacao: 'Right now' pede Present Continuous na resposta.
exercises.dica: Responda no mesmo tempo da pergunta.

exercises.question: The luggage is _____. (he - possessive pronoun)
exercises.explicacao: 'His' funciona como adjetivo e pronome possessivo.
exercises.dica: His é igual nas duas formas.

exercises.question: Complete: 'The pictures are _____.' (she - possessive pronoun)
exercises.explicacao: Sem substantivo após, usamos o pronome possessivo 'hers'.
exercises.dica: Her pictures → The pictures are hers.

exercises.question: This cat is _____. (we - possessive pronoun)
exercises.explicacao: 'Ours' é o pronome possessivo para 'we'.
exercises.dica: Our cat → This cat is ours.

exercises.question: What's the past simple of 'go'?
exercises.explicacao: 'Go' tem passado irregular: go → went → gone.
exercises.dica: É um verbo irregular muito comum.

exercises.question: Complete the rhyme: 'I'm having lots of fun. How about _____?'
exercises.explicacao: Esta é a frase repetida no poema: 'How about you?'
exercises.dica: Releia o refrão do poema sobre o clima.

exercises.question: What's the weather like when you need an umbrella? ☔
exercises.explicacao: We use an umbrella to protect ourselves from the rain.
exercises.dica: What protects you from getting wet?

exercises.question: We _____ students.
exercises.explicacao: With the pronoun 'We', we always use 'are' for the verb to be.
exercises.dica: You, we, and they use 'are'.

exercises.question: Complete: 'He _____ a doctor.'
exercises.explicacao: With 'he', we use 'is' in the present tense of the verb to be.
exercises.dica: He, she, and it use 'is'.

exercises.question: They _____ at the park yesterday.
exercises.explicacao: In the past tense, with 'they' we use 'were'.
exercises.dica: You, we, they use 'were' in the past.

exercises.question: Complete the negative form: 'We _____ tired last night.'
exercises.explicacao: 'Weren't' is the negative form of 'were' (were not).
exercises.dica: We use 'were', so the negative is 'weren't'.

exercises.question: There _____ a good movie on TV last night.
exercises.explicacao: We use 'there was' with singular nouns in the past.
exercises.dica: 'A good movie' is singular, so we use 'was'.

exercises.question: Complete: 'There _____ ten apples in the basket.'
exercises.explicacao: 'Ten apples' is plural, so we use 'there were' in the past.
exercises.dica: Numbers greater than one are always plural.

exercises.question: A turtle is _____ than a rabbit. (slow)
exercises.explicacao: For short adjectives, we add '-er' to form the comparative.
exercises.dica: Comparative of short adjectives: add '-er'.

exercises.question: Complete: 'This is the _____ book I have ever read.' (interesting)
exercises.explicacao: Long adjectives (3+ syllables) use 'the most + adjective' in the superlative.
exercises.dica: Long adjectives use 'most' in the superlative.

exercises.question: This homework is _____ than the last one. (bad)
exercises.explicacao: 'Bad' has an irregular comparative: bad → worse → worst.
exercises.dica: Bad, worse, worst - it's an exception!

exercises.question: Complete: 'This is _____ house.' (they - possessive adjective)
exercises.explicacao: Before a noun, we use the possessive adjective 'their'.
exercises.dica: Before nouns: my, your, his, her, its, our, their.

exercises.question: The dog is _____. (he - possessive pronoun)
exercises.explicacao: 'His' is the possessive pronoun for 'he'.
exercises.dica: His dog → The dog is his.

exercises.question: I _____ my teeth every day.
exercises.explicacao: In the Present Simple, with 'I' the verb does not change.
exercises.dica: I, you, we, they → verb without 's'.

exercises.question: He _____ soccer on weekends. (play)
exercises.explicacao: With 'he', we add 's' to the verb in the Present Simple.
exercises.dica: He plays (3rd person adds 's').

exercises.question: Complete the negative: 'She _____ coffee.'
exercises.explicacao: For he, she, it we use 'doesn't' + verb.
exercises.dica: Doesn't = does not (for he, she, it).

exercises.question: Look! The birds _____ in the sky. (fly - Present Continuous)
exercises.explicacao: Present Continuous: verb to be + verb + ing (action happening now).
exercises.dica: 'Look!' indicates Present Continuous.

exercises.question: Complete: 'What _____ you _____? It looks interesting.' (read - Present Continuous)
exercises.explicacao: Question in the Present Continuous: What are you reading?
exercises.dica: The action is happening now.

exercises.question: I _____ my homework at the moment. (do - Present Continuous)
exercises.explicacao: Action happening now = Present Continuous (am + doing).
exercises.dica: 'At the moment' indicates a current action.

exercises.question: Complete the negative: 'They _____ to the party now.'
exercises.explicacao: Negative in the Present Continuous: are not (aren't) + verb + ing.
exercises.dica: 'Now' indicates Present Continuous.

exercises.question: My birthday is _____ January.
exercises.explicacao: We use 'in' for months and years.
exercises.dica: in January, in 2025.

exercises.question: The meeting is _____ Monday.
exercises.explicacao: We use 'on' for days of the week.
exercises.dica: on Monday, on Friday.

exercises.question: The class starts _____ 9 a.m.
exercises.explicacao: We use 'at' for specific times.
exercises.dica: at 9 o'clock, at midnight.

exercises.question: What is the past simple of 'eat'?
exercises.explicacao: 'Eat' has an irregular past: eat → ate → eaten.
exercises.dica: It's a common irregular verb.

exercises.question: She _____ to the cinema yesterday. (go)
exercises.explicacao: The past simple of 'go' is 'went'.
exercises.dica: go -> went

exercises.question: What is the past simple of 'see'?
exercises.explicacao: 'See' has an irregular past: see → saw → seen.
exercises.dica: It's a common irregular verb.
